title: Where Should a Document Live: Context, Representations, or Parameters?
abstract: arXiv:2609.17346v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To answer questions outside of their pre-training data, large language models (LLMs) need access to new information, which can be presented in the context window as documents, encoded into the model's parameters, or injected as latent representations. However, each of these methods comes with different efficiency, cost, and performance trade-offs, with no single winner. We present a controlled comparison of representation-based (KV-cache based) and parametric (fine-tuning-based) adaptation methods on five knowledge-intensive benchmarks. We show that in the oracle setting, Cartridges (KV) are the most accurate injection method at nearly every storage budget, outperforming parametric methods by 10 points. Compaction (KV) matches Cartridges only at low compression rates, lagging behind the parametric methods by 10 points at rates higher than $50\times$. translated_title: 文档应该存在于何处：上下文、表示还是参数？
translated_abstract: 为了回答超出预训练数据范围的问题，大语言模型（LLM）需要获取新信息，这些信息可以作为文档呈现在上下文窗口中，可以编码到模型参数中，或者作为潜在表示注入。然而，这些方法中的每一种都存在不同的效率、成本和性能权衡，没有单一的赢家。我们在五个知识密集型基准上对基于表示的（基于KV缓存的）和参数化的（基于微调的）适应方法进行了受控比较。我们表明，在oracle设置下，Cartridges（KV缓存）几乎在每个存储预算下都是最准确的注入方法，比参数化方法高出10个百分点。Compaction（KV缓存）仅在低压缩率下与Cartridges相当，在高于50倍的压缩率下比参数化方法落后10个百分点。在更现实的多文档检索场景中，Cartridges是唯一的方法（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文通过对基于KV缓存的Cartridges方法与基于微调的参数化方法在五个知识密集型基准上的受控比较，发现Cartridges几乎在任何存储预算下都是最准确的知识注入方式，而Compaction方法仅在高压缩率以下才具竞争力。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a controlled comparison of KV-cache-based (Cartridges) and parametric fine-tuning adaptation methods across five knowledge-intensive benchmarks, showing that Cartridges are the most accurate knowledge injection method at nearly every storage budget, outperforming parametric methods by 10 points, while Compaction only matches them at low compression rates.
